answer.reason: The verses state a few events of Ishmael's life beyond the relations in the summary: his circumcision, God's blessing on him, and his burying Abraham.

clauses.english: was circumcised at thirteen years old with Abraham
clauses.quote: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised

clauses.english: was blessed by God, who promised to make him fruitful and a great nation
clauses.quote: I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly

clauses.english: helped Isaac bury Abraham in the cave of Machpelah
clauses.quote: his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah

doubts: GEN 16:11-12 is the angel's prediction to Hagar about the child, so it was left out as not an event of his life.
The verses on his sons, daughters and death only list names or give his age, so they were not used.
